title: Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh
excerpt: Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh you should enjoy at least once in your life to feel the delicious flavors such as: crispy rice, mountain goat, mountain snails… and many more interesting things are waiting for you to discover. Ninh Binh
html:
Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh you should enjoy at least once in your life to feel the delicious flavors such as: crispy rice, mountain goat, mountain snails… and many more interesting things are waiting for you to discover.

Ninh Binh Crispy Rice

A delicious and attractive dish in Ninh Binh, visitors can not only enjoy it on the spot, but can also buy it as a gift for friends and relatives during their trip to Ninh Binh.

Mountain goat meat

Ninh Binh goats are raised on rocky mountains so the meat is very delicious, and when processed by talented chefs, it will bring a famous delicious flavor. Goat meat can be processed into many different delicious dishes such as: Grilled goat, steamed goat, raw goat with lemon, goat spring rolls, stir-fried goat, goat with ginger sauce, …

Ninh Binh mountain snails

This is a fairly common snail species, with many types of sea snails, river snails, … especially in Ninh Binh, snails often live in Tam Diep limestone mountain caves, to enjoy this attractive dish, visitors should go on a Ninh Binh tour from April to August, in addition, the snails will not come out and lie deep in the crevices of the rocks.

Snails can be processed into many different dishes, but steamed snails are the most attractive, and can also be processed into salads, steamed with ginger, stir-fried with tamarind … snails have a natural sweet and crispy texture, which will make diners remember Ninh Binh mountain snails forever.

Eel Vermicelli

The dish is very elaborately prepared, the broth from eel bones and marrow bones creates a natural sweet taste, diners enjoy the fragrant and fatty eel meat, eaten with shredded banana flowers, all blending together to create a delicious and attractive flavor.

Eel fish salad

This is a delicious and attractive dish you should try when you have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, at first glance the fish looks quite similar to eel, but the size is a bit larger, and has high nutritional value, a suitable dish for summer days.

Yen Mac sour sausage

This is a dish that many tourists often buy as a gift for their visit to Ninh Binh, the dish is based on Hue royal dishes, eaten with ginseng leaves, fig leaves or perilla leaves to bring a delicious and unique flavor.

Gia Vien Shrimp Paste

A dish with the rich flavor of the ancient capital of Ninh Binh, to have a delicious shrimp paste dish, it will be meticulously processed through skillful hands, bringing delicious food that visitors can buy as gifts when coming to Ninh Binh.

Nho Quan Can Wine

This is a typical wine of the Muong people living in the Nho Quan land. The ingredients are made from sticky rice, rice, potatoes, and wine yeast made from forest leaves such as guava leaves, ginger roots, galangal roots, etc. Through the skillful hands of the Muong people of Nho Quan, it will bring a delicious flavor.

Ninh Binh Floating Cake

A traditional snack made from sticky rice combined with molasses, peanuts and moldy chrysanthemum leaves to create a delicious flavor.

Gáo Fruit

This is a fruit used to cook soup, which will help to overcome the fishy smell of fish, creating a cool sour taste, visitors can buy it as a gift, the fruit is sold a lot in the markets.

It can be said that there is nothing more interesting than setting foot in the ancient capital of Ninh Binh, visitors can both enjoy the sights and enjoy the delicious dishes, in addition, there are famous specialties that visitors can buy as gifts for friends and relatives. Ninh Binh not only brings visitors beautiful landscapes, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes that attract travelers.
